name: Stabilize
description: Remove shake, gate weave and frame-height breathing
longDescription:
Two independent corrections.

Remove Shake / Weave measures how much the whole frame moves and cancels it, so a shaky capture holds still. Deliberate camera movement survives: only the difference from the recent trend is removed. Use it on telecine weave, film scans that wobble in the gate, and handheld camcorder footage.

Pitch Correction removes "breathing" in scanned 8mm, Super 8 and 16mm film: on pull-through scanners the film slips in the gate, so each frame comes out a fraction of a percent taller or shorter than the last, which a position stabiliser can't fix. Auto measures it from the footage, comparing each frame with its neighbours, so slow intentional zooms and tilts are kept. From File uses one factor per frame from a text file (reel.pitch.txt next to the video is picked up automatically).

The pass runs last before cropping, because both corrections move picture within the frame and leave thin edges: fill them below, or crop them away afterwards.

methods.name: Stab
methods.description: Motion-analysis stabilisation via MVTools. Cancels shake while leaving intended camera movement alone

ui.label: Remove Shake / Weave
ui.description: Steady frame-to-frame bounce, side-to-side drift and handheld shake

ui.label: Max Horizontal Shift
ui.description: Largest sideways correction, in pixels. 0 leaves the horizontal axis alone

ui.label: Max Vertical Shift
ui.description: Largest up/down correction, in pixels. 0 leaves the vertical axis alone

ui.label: Fill Exposed Edges
ui.description: Shifting the picture leaves thin empty edges. 0 leaves them black, 1 fills top and bottom, 2 left and right, 3 all four — which saves cropping afterwards

ui.label: Pitch Correction
ui.description: Even out frame-height breathing from film slipping in a scanner's gate

ui.label: Max Pitch Correction (%)
ui.description: Largest height change applied to a frame; also limits values from a file. Auto measures more coarsely above about 1%, so keep it near the breathing you see

ui.label: Comparison Window
ui.description: Frames each side a frame is compared with. Larger smooths more but follows quick zooms less closely

ui.label: Factors Are Corrections
ui.description: Tick if the file lists the stretch to apply, not the measured frame height

ui.label: Pitch Edge Fill
ui.description: What fills the rows a pitch correction moves in from outside the frame
